what_happened: Research pass found no gaps: the ruling decision record (slice-command-one-path-to-review.md) fully specifies the design, and the local codebase already contains a complete worked precedent (review-stack-prepare.sh's overlay primitive, commands/tag.md and commands/merge.md command-file shapes, manifest.json/suite-classification.data registration, and the orchestrator-runtime-files.md gitignore-class precedent for the series file), so no external research or design work was needed -- only codebase verification and precedent location.
